integration: Split into two cells, crop alpha bounds, uniformly downsample into native per-frame bounds on 99x99 square canvases; no upsampling or manual redraw. Pack using sprite-atlas-sources/build.py then compress final atlas with tinypng-batch.
review: Both poses face right with mustard hard hat, tan skin and blue trousers. Left arm down; right arm raised. High-resolution continuous contours replace pixel tiles. Original per-frame position, size, loop timing and scenery movement remain authoritative.
